verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a Bevy headless run mode, a windowless or no-render configuration, or CI usage. The only related items are adjacent: Bevy is a normal Rust dependency with a code-first cargo workflow that needs no editor, which reflects host toolchain behavior rather than a Bevy headless capability. The first-party Bevy Remote Protocol is mentioned only as the basis for community tooling, not as a headless/CI mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
